profile_text.body:
OneTrust, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, describes itself as helping companies manage privacy, consent, and AI governance while automating compliance and reducing risk to build trust and drive innovation. The company positions the OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform as a system that connects privacy, data, AI, and technology risk in one continuous platform, allowing organizations to define purpose, automate assessments, enforce controls, and continuously monitor new risks across domains.

The company offers OneTrust AI Governance, categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform with a privacy-first approach emphasizing data governance and compliance automation. According to its site, OneTrust provides a continuous, real-time view of how data and AI are used to help prevent issues before they escalate, and embeds governance into data and AI workflows so teams can move faster with clear oversight. The platform addresses third-party management, risk assessments, and compliance and governance functions across multiple data flows and vendor ecosystems.
